label: Device Address
description: Modbus unit id the device answers to

label: Device Heartbeat
description: Counter the device increments every cycle; a frozen value means the device application is hung even if Modbus answers

label: Controller Heartbeat
description: Counter the EMS/PPC writes every cycle; a controllable device falls back to its reversion values when it stops changing

label: AC Wiring Type
description: AC wiring of the device; DER and meters

label: Max Active Power Rating
description: Nameplate max active power at unity PF; every DER (BESS/PV/genset)

label: Max Absorbed var Rating
description: Nameplate max reactive power absorbed (under-excited; magnitude)

label: Nominal AC Voltage Rating
description: Nominal line-to-line AC voltage at the device terminals
